evidence.title: False claims that drinking water with lemon can prevent COVID-19 ...
evidence.snippet_en: AFP Fact Check rated as "False" the claim that drinking lemon and warm water can prevent novel coronavirus disease.

outputs.notes_en: The claim is about drinking hot water with lemon juice to destroy coronavirus. I found two fact checks directly addressing this claim, both rating it as false. Other fact checks were about similar but distinct claims, such as adding baking soda, other ingredients, or claims about specific countries, so they were not included.
